sn48.54:1.1: seyyathāpi → seyyathāpī (pts) | jaṅgalānaṁ pāṇānaṁ padajātāni → jaṅgalānam pāṇānam padajatāni (pts) | jaṅgalānaṁ → jaṅgamānaṁ (cck: sī. pī.) | jaṅgalānam → S1 jaṅgalāni S3 jaṅgamānaṁ. (pts note) | tāni → missing in S1. (pts note)
